functions.name: F_4DVectorMatrixTransform
functions.summary: 3DNow! 4-component vector-matrix transform (__stdcall). Reads the two packed input quads a2[0], a2[1] (four floats), duplicates each lane with punpckldq/punpckhdq into v4/v6 (from a2[0]) and v7/v8 (from a2[1]), then accumulates the full 4x4 product against the coefficient matrix a3[0..7]: a1[0] = a3[0]*v4 + a3[2]*v6 + a3[4]*v7 + a3[6]*v8 and a1[1] = a3[1]*v4 + a3[3]*v6 + a3[5]*v7 + a3[7]*v8 (nested pfmul/pfadd). Writes both output slots a1[0], a1[1], emits _m_femms() at entry and exit, and returns a1. Unlike F_4DVectorTransform (00526550) there is no reciprocal/w-divide step, so this is the pure matrix multiply form. No guards, no callees.

operations.description: Emit _m_femms() at function entry and again before return to exit MMX/3DNow state.

Load both packed input quads: m64_u64 = a2[0] and v5 = a2[1], then duplicate each component into paired lanes: v4 = punpckldq(a2[0],a2[0]), v6 = punpckhdq(a2[0],a2[0]), v7 = punpckldq(v5,v5), v8 = punpckhdq(v5,v5).

Accumulate the first output quad a1[0] = pfadd(pfadd(pfmul(v4, a3[0]), pfmul(v6, a3[2])), pfadd(pfmul(v7, a3[4]), pfmul(v8, a3[6]))): each of the four input components times its matrix column (columns 0, 2, 4, 6).
Accumulate the second output quad v9 = pfadd(pfadd(pfmul(v4, a3[1]), pfmul(v6, a3[3])), pfadd(pfmul(v7, a3[5]), pfmul(v8, a3[7]))): the remaining four matrix columns.
Store both results into the output buffer: a1[0] = computed first quad and a1[1] = v9.
Return the output buffer pointer a1.

functions.name: Matrix2x2Transform3DNow
functions.summary: Applies a 2x2 linear transform to four packed input pairs using 3DNow! intrinsics. The four coefficients of the 2x2 matrix in a2 (two __m64) are splatted into replicated pairs (v4, v6 from a2[0]; v7, v8 from a2[1]), then each output pair is the sum of four a3 pairs weighted by those coefficients: output[0] uses a3[0]/a3[2]/a3[4]/a3[6], output[1] uses a3[1]/a3[3]/a3[5]/a3[7]. Results are stored to a1[0] and a1[1]. MMX state is cleared with _m_femms at entry and exit, and the output buffer a1 is returned. The packet's ABI name Matrix2x2_3DNow is LEGACY-trusted.

Splat the two float coefficients of a2[1] (m10, m11) into replicated pairs v7 and v8 via punpckldq/punpckhdq.
Compute output pair 1 as v4*a3[1] + v6*a3[3] + v7*a3[5] + v8*a3[7] using pfmul and pfadd.
Compute output pair 0 as v4*a3[0] + v6*a3[2] + v7*a3[4] + v8*a3[6] using pfmul and pfadd.
Store output pair 0 into a1 at offset 0x0.
Store output pair 1 into a1 at offset 0x8.
Clear MMX/3DNow state via _m_femms at exit.
Return the output buffer pointer a1.

functions.name: FixedPointIDCTColorTransform
functions.summary: Fixed-point inverse discrete cosine transform with a per-block color/output transform, per the legacy ABI name Fixed_Point_IDCT_Color_Transform. Two phases: an 8-iteration column pass over a block of 16-bit samples (coefficient base read from a2 + 80, sample buffer at a3 + 96) writing intermediate results into a stack buffer, then a 4-iteration record pass that runs the same fixed-point butterfly set, biases/shifts (>> 19 with 0x40000) and maps the four outputs through a 1024-entry lookup table whose base is read from a1 + 0x11C plus 128, writing four bytes per pixel at offsets given by a4 into a5. Both passes contain an all-zero fast path that emits a DC-only value.

operations.description: Read the coefficient/container object pointer from a2 + 80 (its data lives at +96).
Read the lookup-table base from a1 + 0x11C and add 128 to form the transform output table base v48.
Point v7 at the input sample array a3 + 96 and v9 at the coefficient array v5 + 96; v8 targets the stack scratch buffer v44.
Column pass: do-while loop of 8 iterations (v51 from 8 down to 0) over the input sample buffer.
Skip the pass body for the iteration where v51 == 4.
Load the eight 16-bit input samples (v7[-48], v7[-40], v7[-32], v7[-24], v7[-8], v7[0], v7[8]) and the matching coefficient words from v9.
All-zero fast path: when the OR of the six non-DC sample words (v53 | v50 | v11 | v10 | v56 | v13) is zero, use the DC-only shortcut.
DC-only shortcut: v16 = 4 * DC_sample * DC_coefficient, stored to the three output slots (v8[-8], v8[0], v8[16]).
Full path: fixed-point butterfly first stage with coefficients 15137 and 6270 and a << 14 DC term, then a second stage with 8697, 11893, 1730, 17799, 20995, 7373, 4926, 4176.
Form the four output values (v24, v25, v26, v27) with a 2048 rounding bias and store them >> 12 into the stack scratch buffer v44.
Advance v7, v8 and v9 and decrement v51 at the end of each column-pass iteration.
Output pass: do-while loop of 4 iterations (v52 from 0 to 3) over 32-byte records starting at v43.
Compute the output pixel pointer result = a5 + a4[4 * v52]; the four output offsets come from the caller-supplied array a4.
Skip the transform body when the OR of the six dwords of the record (v28+1..v28+7) is zero (all-zero block).
All-zero block fast path: look up ((DC + 16) >> 5) & 0x3FF in the output table and write the same byte to result[0], result[1] and result[3].
Full block: second fixed-point butterfly using the same coefficient set (15137/6270 first stage, 8697/11893/1730/17799/20995/7373/4926/4176 second stage) with a << 14 DC term.
Map the four result values through the 1024-entry lookup table: byte = table[((value + 0x40000) >> 19) & 0x3FF] with base v48, written to result[0], result[1], result[2], result[3].
Return the last output pointer result.
